visual.general_description: Case timeline diagram of nine icon-and-text boxes along a red horizontal line.
visual.detailed_description: Wide landscape timeline diagram on a white background: a thick horizontal red line with small triangular pointers on it and one small dark blue dot near its right end. Nine rounded boxes with dark navy header bars alternate above (four boxes) and below (five boxes) the line, ordered left to right. Each header bar carries a printed date label (month and day or month only), and two headers also carry a time-of-day label; the date and time labels are not transcribed here. Box bodies hold bulleted text and a small icon. Bottom, first: 'onset of depression (without seeking any help)' with a head icon holding tangled marks. Top, first: 'suicidal attempt' and 'unvoluntary psychiatric hospitalisation' with an ambulance icon. Bottom, second: 'informent. consent. with examinations', 'EEG assessment', 'MADRS', 'C-SSRS' with a head icon showing waves and a checklist-paper icon. Top, second: 'initiation of antidepressant medication' and 'psychotherapy' with a hand-and-pills icon. Bottom, third: 'EEG assessment', 'MADRS', 'C-SSRS', 'psychodiagnostic examination including ROSCHACH test' with a sun-like radiating icon and a head icon with waves. Top, third: 'discharge from psychiatric hospital' and '60% reduction in MADRS' with a doorway-and-figure icon. Bottom, fourth: 'outpatient psychiatric check up', 'MADRS', 'C-SSRS' with a clinician icon. Top, fourth: 'completed suicide by jumping from heights' with a building-and-falling-figure icon. Bottom, fifth: 'analyzing QEEG records to evaluate the change of theta prefrontal cordance in first day verzus 7th day of hospitalisation' with a magnifying-glass-over-wave icon. Spellings are as printed.

visual.general_description: Two QEEG report panels (A, B), each with four colour topographic maps and an electrode-by-band cordance table.
visual.detailed_description: Panel A is titled for the 2nd day of hospitalisation and panel B for the 9th day, shown side by side. Screenshot-style QEEG report panel titled in the image 'Theta prefrontal cordance on 2nd day of hospitalisation'. A thin ruler strip with small tick labels runs along the top edge of the grey map area. Four circular head-shaped topographic colour maps (red, white and blue shading, with L and R side labels) are arranged in a 2 by 2 grid inside a grey frame, each with a caption of the frequency range printed beneath it and a small red-and-blue colour key with two printed numbers at its upper right. Captions: '0.5-4.0 Hz [1- 8]', '4.0-8.0 Hz [8-16]' (this map has a thick black outline), '8.0-12.0 Hz [16-24]' and '12.0-19.5 Hz [24-40]'. In this panel the 0.5-4.0 Hz map is red over much of its upper area with blue lower down, the 4.0-8.0 Hz map mixes blue, white and red bands, the 8.0-12.0 Hz map is blue above and red below, and the 12.0-19.5 Hz map is mostly red. Beneath the maps a monospaced text table lists electrodes Fp1-GND, Fp2-GND, F7-GND, F3-GND, Fz-GND, F4-GND and F8-GND against columns Delta, Theta, Alpha, Beta and Total with their frequency ranges. In the Theta column black rectangles outline the Fp1-GND, Fp2-GND and Fz-GND cells, which print 0.35, 0.30 and 0.34. Other cell values were not transcribed. Screenshot-style QEEG report panel titled in the image 'Theta prefrontal cordance on 9th day of hospitalisation'. A thin ruler strip with small tick labels runs along the top edge of the grey map area. Four circular head-shaped topographic colour maps (red, white and blue shading, with L and R side labels) are arranged in a 2 by 2 grid inside a grey frame, each with a caption of the frequency range printed beneath it and a small red-and-blue colour key with two printed numbers at its upper right. Captions: '0.5-4.0 Hz [1- 8]', '4.0-8.0 Hz [8-16]' (this map has a thick black outline), '8.0-12.0 Hz [16-24]' and '12.0-19.0 Hz [24-39]'. In this panel the 0.5-4.0 Hz map is red with a blue patch, the 4.0-8.0 Hz map has blue and white areas above with red below right, the 8.0-12.0 Hz map is mostly red, and the 12.0-19.0 Hz map is red above with white and pale blue below. Beneath the maps a monospaced text table lists electrodes Fp1-GND, Fp2-GND, F7-GND, F3-GND, Fz-GND, F4-GND and F8-GND against columns Delta, Theta, Alpha, Beta and Total with their frequency ranges. In the Theta column black rectangles outline the Fp1-GND, Fp2-GND and Fz-GND cells, which print 0.55, 0.42 and 0.32. Other cell values were not transcribed.
